customer: Hi, I finaly paid off my car loan last month (its a coupe) but when I looked at the title the bank is still listed as lienholder?? I work nights as a nurse so its hard for me to call during the day, can I still sell the car to you or do I have to wait for this to get fixed. Live in California if that matters.
agent: Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on paying off your loan! If the lender is still listed on the title, the lien hasn't been released yet, so the first step is to ask your lender for a lien release letter; if you can't get one, you can sign our lien release request, form NW-LRL-1, and we'll contact the lender for you, which can add 1 to 2 weeks. You don't have to wait to get started, as we can still make an offer and book your appointment while the release is in progress. Also, in states with electronic titles, the lender sends the release to the state electronically.
